text:
One woman has poisoned my soul,
another woman has poisoned my body;
neither of them came looking for me,
and I blame neither of them.

The world is round, and so the world turns.
If tomorrow, as it turns, this poison
poisons someone else, why blame me?
Can I give more than I was given?

translation.title: Rhyme LXXX: One Woman Has Poisoned My Soul
